name: Suaza (Colombia)
description: Green field with a yellow diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly and a yellow ring with an orchid at the upper hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Suaza, a municipality in the department of Huila, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
